maria-ops: Heads-up: planning a phased unpin of runtime 2.14 -> 2.15 tonight (eu-west first). Window 22:30-01:30 UTC. Main driver: kernel fixes that reduce tail latency for batch workloads. Small wrinkle: mobile clients on sdk@2.3 report a cert/signature mismatch that blocks automatic runtime routing.

leo-platform: Noted. Telemetry comparison shows overall token throughput +4% on 2.15, but we see occasional p95 jumps under bursty 32k seq tests. Would prefer 1% canary for 45m with server-only routing first.

maria-ops: Agreed. Proposed rollout:
- 22:30 eu-west canary 1% (only routes with header X-Client-Type: server) for 45m
- 23:15 bump to 10% (exclude mobile user agents) for 20m
- 23:35 50% for 25m then evaluate for full rollout

devex: Can we implement header-based gating? We can add an AB flag as a fallback. Also will update SDK compat table and note the temporary shim steps for mobile.

infra-bot: [automated] change created: unpin runtime-2.14 -> runtime-2.15 for model-set 'v2-performance'. Canary policy: 1% -> 10% -> 50%. Auto-abort if error_rate > 1.2% OR regression p95 > 30% OR kvcache misses increase > 4%.

nora-qa: I'll run targeted regressions against the canary endpoints (kv integrity, repeated-token stability, streaming cutover). If any of the three core tests fail we'll signal rollback. ETA results 23:15.

maria-ops: Rollback snippets (put in runbook):
```
# CLI emergency rollback
deployctl rollback --target runtime-2.14 --selector "model-set=v2-performance" --reason "canary-failure"
# API option
POST /internal/deploy/rollback
Header: Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN
Body: {"target":"runtime-2.14","selector":"model-set=v2-performance"}
```
Also: staged rollback (partial) available via deployctl --percent N.

leo-platform: I'll monitor kcache hit rate and kernel OOM logs. If kvcache miss delta > 4% or kernel OOM frequency observed, request immediate rollback.

devex: Publishing notes: add "If you run mobile sdk@2.3, please apply runtime-routing-shim v0.9 or update to sdk@2.4 when available." Will drop a short snippet and the header-gating example.

maria-ops: Ok final checks: tagging @nora-qa and @leo-platform on-call. Starting canary at 22:30 UTC. If deploybot reports anomalies we'll abort and run rollback.

deploybot: [automated] canary initiated: eu-west model-set 'v2-performance' 1% (header-gated: X-Client-Type=server). Monitoring windows open. Progress updates will be posted here. :rocket:
